data.title: Act One | Act Two
data.about:
CT I & ACT II are the epitome of luxury located in Dubai’s most coveted address, Downtown Dubai. The latest limited time period offer on Emaar’s Act I | Act II towers in Dubai Opera District is VALID FOR JUST THIS WEEK. 

Avail a 3-year post-handover payment plan for 2, 3, and 4 BR apartments, and a BRAND NEW FIRST-TIME RELEASE of 3 & 4 BR Villas facing Burj Park. These homes offer enviable views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Dancing Fountains.
